This line predicts a 243-pound dog.

w = 4m + 3 fits a puppy from 2 to 6 months, but at 60 months it predicts 243 pounds. Lines of best fit only work inside the data's range.

tiktok_caption: This line predicts a 243-pound dog. Don't trust a line of best fit outside the data.

youtube.title: Why You Can't Trust a Line Outside the Data
youtube.description: A line of best fit is reliable only within the range of the data. Using it far outside that range, called extrapolation, can give absurd predictions.
